prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were consistently too high across all tests compared to noise-corrected results.
Evidence is still thin for all change types because each kind of change has only a single test so far.
No clear effect was seen for sign_in notification, sign_in hint, choose_path reorder, or home notification changes.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: -7.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, copy: -5.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, reorder: +1.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_flow: +9.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, notification: -0.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: +4.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, hint: +1.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, notification: +1.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 86.8%, median 201s / mean 2336s

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Interactive Pet Personality & Customizer Stage: Redesign the companion selection step into an interactive stage layout where users tune pet traits and preview behavior. (why: Adoption conversion is low at 60.9% with a high mean time of 1017s; a structured stage layout helps users make choices faster.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Customization Photo Audit Screen: Insert a new photo verification screen before upload to ensure submitted photos meet rendering criteria. (why: Support received 3 emails reporting custom pet generation failures or unexpected visuals, causing adoption drop-offs.)
2: [choose_path, reorder] Story Screen First Onboarding Reordering: Reorder the introductory story screen to present an interactive scrollable narrative before path selection. (why: 23.8% of users leave at choose_path within 8 seconds; establishing emotional investment early reduces fast drop-outs.)
3: [sign_in, layout] Split Account Continuity & Restore View: Re-layout the sign-in step into a two-column split screen highlighting account sync and pet saving benefits. (why: Sign-in conversion drops to 72.9% and 8 support emails cited missing or reset pets after signing back in.)
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Interaction Cheat-Sheet Wait Overlay: Add an interactive shortcut guide and gesture cheat sheet to the waiting screen. (why: Home waiting step has a 201s median / 2336s mean time, and users later complain about unclear pet controls.)
5: [choose_path, copy] Path Selection Value-Focused Headline Refresh: Update choose_path headline and body to directly compare instant ready-made pets versus custom photo creation. (why: 23.8% drop-off at choose_path occurs within a median of 8 seconds due to rapid decision friction.)
